test_purpose: Rejection: catering over cap, alcohol, portable assets, profit, limited to one provider. Tests the plain-English letter. All organisations, people and ABNs are fictional.

project.title: International Student Sunset Networking Cruise
project.description: A three-hour sunset cruise on Darwin Harbour where students can network with local employers. Tickets will be sold to students for $40 each and any surplus will be retained by the company to support future events. A beer and wine package will be served on board.
project.who_can_attend: Students enrolled at one Darwin university.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Students can make professional contacts in a relaxed setting.
